notes: Rate limiting not present in current FastAPI stack; implemented as middleware without expanding scope.

change_log.value: Added schema/contract story for rate limiting policy
Added core logic story for rate limiting engine
Added test and integration validation story

BL-0.1.4-008-S1.title: Define Rate Limiting Policy Schema and Contract
BL-0.1.4-008-S1.description: Define configurable rate limiting rules including request thresholds, time windows, and client identification strategy (IP/session). Establish contract for how limits are declared and consumed by middleware.
BL-0.1.4-008-S1.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/main.py (FastAPI entrypoint supports middleware injection); ASSUMPTION: No existing rate limit schema; GAP required

BL-0.1.4-008-S2.title: Implement Rate Limiting Core Logic
BL-0.1.4-008-S2.description: Build rate limiting engine to track request counts per client and enforce thresholds using in-memory or lightweight store. Include sliding window or fixed window logic.
BL-0.1.4-008-S2.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/infrastructure/debug_logger.py (demonstrates request metadata tracking patterns); ASSUMPTION: No reusable limiter exists; GAP required

BL-0.1.4-008-S3.title: Integrate Rate Limiting Middleware into FastAPI
BL-0.1.4-008-S3.description: Add middleware to FastAPI app to enforce rate limits on incoming requests. Return standardized HTTP 429 responses when limits are exceeded.
BL-0.1.4-008-S3.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/main.py (central request handling and middleware insertion point); ASSUMPTION: No existing rate limiting middleware; GAP required

BL-0.1.4-008-S4.title: Rate Limiting Tests and Integration Validation
BL-0.1.4-008-S4.description: Create unit tests for rate limiting logic and integration tests validating 429 responses under load and normal behavior under threshold.
BL-0.1.4-008-S4.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/tests/test_tool_router.py (existing testing patterns); ASSUMPTION: No rate limit tests exist; GAP required

BL-0.1.4-008.mitigation: Use simple in-memory limiting scoped to single instance; avoid distributed complexity
